Container.Name: fluxer-aio
Container.Overview: Fluxer (open-source chat: text, voice, video) in ONE container. Unofficial: not affiliated with or supported by the Fluxer project.[br][br] Inside: Fluxer api, gateway, media-proxy and Rust services, plus NATS, Meilisearch, LiveKit (voice) and an internal HTTP router. You provide: a Postgres database, a Redis/Valkey server and a reverse proxy with TLS for your domain.[br][br] Before the first start: create the Postgres role and database (CREATE ROLE fluxer LOGIN PASSWORD '...'; CREATE DATABASE fluxer OWNER fluxer;), point your reverse proxy at this container's HTTP port (all paths, websockets on), and forward TCP 7881 + UDP 7882 on your router for voice/video.[br][br] Updates: before a new Fluxer release first starts, the container backs up and validates the Fluxer database into /data/backups (keeps 3 good ones); if that fails, Fluxer is not started and the log says why.[br][br] First start: the log prints a setup token ('[fluxer-aio-init] first start: setup token ...'); open https://your-domain and enter it to create the admin account. Secrets are generated once into /data/secrets.env: back up the Data folder (and your Postgres database). Several of those secrets must never change.[br][br] Every service logs to the container log with a [service] prefix. The health check names the first failing service.
Container.Requires: An external Postgres (16+) with an empty 'fluxer' database, a Redis/Valkey server, a reverse proxy with TLS for your domain, and router forwards for TCP 7881 and UDP 7882 (voice/video). Upstream suggests at least 4 GB of RAM.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Plain HTTP for your reverse proxy (it terminates TLS and forwards everything here). Pick any free host port.

Config.Name: Voice TCP Port
Config.Description: LiveKit voice/video over TCP. Forward this port on your router; calls do not go through the reverse proxy. Keep host and container port the same.

Config.Name: Voice UDP Port
Config.Description: LiveKit voice/video over UDP (preferred by clients). Forward this port on your router. Keep host and container port the same.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Generated secrets (secrets.env), uploaded files (objects/), search index, NATS state. Back this up.

Config.Name: Domain
Config.Description: Public domain Fluxer runs on, served by your reverse proxy (e.g. chat.example.com).

Config.Name: Postgres Host
Config.Description: Host or IP of your Postgres server. From a bridge-network container, use the Unraid IP for a Postgres on the host network.

Config.Name: Postgres Password
Config.Description: Password of the Fluxer Postgres role.

Config.Name: Redis URL
Config.Description: redis://host:6379/1 (or redis://:password@host:6379/1). Use a database number no other app uses.

Config.Name: API DB Connections
Config.Description: Postgres pool of the api and its embedded worker (upstream default 25).

Config.Name: Users DB Connections
Config.Description: Postgres pool of the users service (upstream default 20).

Config.Name: Messages DB Connections
Config.Description: Postgres pool of the messages service (upstream default 20).

Config.Name: Voice Public IP
Config.Description: Your public IP for voice/video. Leave empty to detect it via STUN; if set, also set Voice Detect IP to false.

Config.Name: Voice Detect IP
Config.Description: true = LiveKit finds its public IP via STUN. false when Voice Public IP is set.

Config.Name: TURN Servers
Config.Description: Optional JSON list of TURN servers for clients on networks that block UDP (see Fluxer docs).

Config.Name: UID
Config.Description: User ID the services run as (Unraid default nobody = 99).

Config.Name: GID
Config.Description: Group ID the services run as (Unraid default users = 100).
